item.title: Albert Einstein’s brain was stolen by a doctor and carried around for 40 years
item.description: Albert Einstein’s death in 1955 set off an extraordinary and ethically fraught afterlife for his brain, secretly removed by a hospital pathologist and kept for decades. Intended as a scientific quest, the episode instead became a prolonged saga of disputed consent, questionable research, and a specimen that wandered far from Einstein’s own wishes before finally reaching museums.

item.title: Women drugged and raped by Colorado cardiologist on dates sue Tinder and Hinge for ‘accommodating rapists’
item.description: Six women have filed a lawsuit against Match Group, the parent company of Hinge. They accuse the dating platform of negligence. The suit claims repeated reports about a former cardiologist were ignored. This allowed him to continue assaulting women he met on the app. The women seek damages and want dating apps to improve safety measures.

item.title: Kai Cenat gets real about mental health struggles in emotional birthday message
item.description: On his 24th birthday, Kai Cenat shared a heartfelt video discussing the mental health struggles behind his success as a streamer. He spoke openly about burnout, self-doubt, and the pressures of constant content creation, urging fans to prioritize mental well-being. The video resonated widely, sparking conversations about the toll of online fame and the importance of self-care for creators.

item.title: Caleb Hammer invites Frogan onto Financial Audit amid Asmongold backlash
item.description: Caleb Hammer invited Twitch streamer Frogan to appear on Financial Audit, offering to match a $10,000 charity donation tied to Asmongold’s involvement or give her $5,000 directly. The move followed Frogan’s viral stream about financial stress and sparked debate over whether the offer represents genuine help or content-driven exploitation amid ongoing streamer backlashes.

item.title: Death row inmate leaves cryptic final words before being executed 36 years after killing a mom
item.description: Mark Allen Geralds was executed in Florida nearly 37 years after murdering Tressa Pettibone in her home. In his final moments, the death row inmate declined a last meal and spiritual counsel, offering only a brief, unclear statement before lethal injection. The execution brought long-awaited finality to a case that had haunted the victim’s family for decades.

item.title: British journalist claims he was offered chance to shoot civilians while visiting war zones
item.description: A British journalist has claimed he was offered the chance to shoot civilians while travelling through active war zones, reigniting scrutiny of long-standing allegations about so-called “sniper tourism.” His account sits alongside an Italian investigation into claims that wealthy foreigners paid to fire on civilians during the Bosnian war, allegations that remain deeply contested but unresolved decades later.

item.title: Height gap draws attention: 5'2 Meloni’s reaction greeting 6'8 Mozambique President goes viral - watch
item.description: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's surprised reaction to the towering height of Mozambique President Daniel Francisco Chapo during a diplomatic meeting in Rome went viral. The significant height difference caused challenges for photographers, leading to humorous online reactions. Beyond the viral moment, the leaders discussed strengthening bilateral partnerships and cooperation in key areas like energy and agriculture.

item.title: 'Whether you are Jewish, Hindu or Christian...': Vivek Ramaswamy cites Bondi Beach attack to defend free worship in America
item.description: Republican Vivek Ramaswamy highlighted America's religious freedom commitment, referencing the Bondi Beach attack to underscore the need for safe worship. He argued that protecting the right to practice faith without fear is central to the nation's identity, a principle he believes is threatened by cultural shifts. His inclusive message emphasizes safeguarding pluralism for all faiths.

item.title: “I don’t want that”: Luke Nichols finally opens up about stepping away from Outdoor Boys and choosing family over fame
item.description: Luke Nichols opened up about why he stepped away from the Outdoor Boys YouTube channel, pointing to nonstop public attention, growing worries about his family’s safety, and a demanding work schedule that became hard to sustain. As the channel’s popularity skyrocketed, Nichols chose a quieter life, valuing privacy, family time, and long-term balance over continued online fame.

item.title: Who is Asmongold’s dating? Exploring Twitch streamers’ past relationships and dating rumors
item.description: Twitch streamer Asmongold's past relationship with fellow streamer Pink Sparkles, which lasted about a year and a half, was a significant chapter. Despite their 2019 breakup, they remained friendly, with Pink Sparkles later discussing their cohabitation. More recently, Asmongold interacted with streamer Kaise in 2024, though no romantic relationship was confirmed.
